target: Restore quarantined parent-summary jobs with sparse legacy metadata and prevent heartbeat from auditing an in-flight native archive transaction.
primary_semantics: Lossless payloads preserve field presence independently from null values, and heartbeat observes or repairs one transactionally consistent archive state.
invariants: Raw dialogue, persisted summaries, pending source assignments, cloud replicas, and trusted-device records are never rewritten or deleted.
Presence metadata changes only the ephemeral AI prompt representation and remains backward-readable when absent.
Raw-integrity and frozen-source SHA-256 checks remain fail closed.
Heartbeat owns the archive lock; callers do not nest the same lock.
A quarantined job is requeued only after the exact saved payload passes the repaired local round trip.
allowed_changes: Add field-presence bitmaps to lossless raw-record and child-summary payloads.
Move archive-lock ownership into heartbeat and remove its duplicate maintenance caller lock.
Add focused regressions, installed-runtime evidence, version metadata, and three-locale release notes.
prohibited_changes: Relax semantic result schemas, source hashes, raw-history integrity checks, or summary ingestion validation.
Rewrite, normalize, delete, or regenerate raw history or existing persisted summaries.
Run a broad full-release rehearsal for this narrow patch.
before_after_checks: Reproduce job-000372 failing before AI because missing metadata keys are restored as null.
Round-trip the exact ten-child saved payload without changing its source files.
Prove heartbeat audit executes while the shared archive lock is held.
Install the candidate, repair only derived views, requeue the one isolated task, and observe a real Level-2 ingest or an evidence-backed downstream failure.

original_triggers: A real Level-2 job with mixed legacy Level-1 metadata failed lossless packing four times before AI invocation and entered quarantine.
Heartbeat could read raw records between the native collector raw append and its derived transcript, index, and state writes.
